outcome: rate of HDP (pre-existing hypertension, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia)
maternal hospital length of stay (>= 7 d)
admission to the maternal intensive care unit
cohort: The study included 2,804,473 hospital admissions for birth in Canada (excluding Quebec) between 2012 and 2021, focusing on females with a diagnosis of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
finding: The rate of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy significantly increased across Canada from 2012 to 2021, while some associated morbidities, such as early preterm delivery and SMM, declined.
mod_finding: Rates of cesarean delivery among females with HDP increased from 42.0% in 2012 to 44.3% in 2021.
